---

`cadence` is one of `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semiannual`, `annual` or
`once`. Leave `interval` off unless the charge falls every second or third
cadence.

`account` is the account every occurrence books to, and it carries through to a
bill made from one. `document` takes one path or a list of them.
